summary: Phase 23 landed and committed green: GHR Lemma 10.2.7 in full as the new UNesting.lean (858 lines, 57 declarations), which compiled on the FIRST build attempt because Phase 22.3's substitution calculus transferred verbatim. The hypothesis is now the decidable structural predicate NoSnceUnderUntl, GHR's licensing sentence about nesting levels is proved rather than asserted (untlDepth_lt_of_mem_innerTypes), and the induction is the budget idiom with the three decrease parts separately named. Two plan deviations, both recorded: sep7Body's base case returns sepMulti rather than the identity (the phase's two statements of its own base case are inconsistent and only this reading is sound), and sep7Fuel_spec carries two conjuncts, read off the proof obligation as the plan directs. All gates green against baseline: zero sorry, zero vacuous introduced, axiom count 14 unchanged, full lake build 0 errors, module-invariants and metalogic-cycles PASS. Phase 24's standing 'size part (c) first' prerequisite was then executed on paper with no code written: the plan's declared stall candidate is NOT a stall, and GHR's duality reduction turns out to be a precondition of the bound rather than a convenience.
